name: @koed/desktop
description: Electron control surface for Koed local personal installs.
author: Koed

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.package:runtime: pnpm --filter @koed/shared build && pnpm --filter @koed/core build && pnpm --filter @koed/db build && pnpm --filter @koed/api build && pnpm --filter @koed/worker build && pnpm --filter @koed/embedding-service build && pnpm --filter @koed/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @koed/explorer build && node scripts/prepare-koed-runtime.mjs
scripts.package:mac: pnpm --filter @koed/koed-server build && pnpm build && pnpm package:runtime && rm -rf release/mac release/mac-* && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir && if [ ! -d release/mac ]; then set -- release/mac-*; [ -d "$1" ] && mv "$1" release/mac; fi
scripts.package:internal:mac: pnpm --filter @koed/koed-server build && pnpm build && pnpm package:runtime && rm -rf release/mac release/mac-* release/*.dmg release/*.zip && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir dmg zip && if [ ! -d release/mac ]; then set -- release/mac-*; [ -d "$1" ] && mv "$1" release/mac; fi
scripts.package:release: pnpm --filter @koed/koed-server build && pnpm build && pnpm package:runtime && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
